meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 它把 Webex 适配器和注册测试复制进 src/channels/，追加一行自注册 import，安装 @bitbasti/chat-adapter-webex，再构建并跑注册测试；Bot Token 等凭证需你手动填写。
howto.when: 当你要给项目加 Webex 渠道支持（例如把 Webex 空间接入 agent）时触发；正文要求已有 channels 分支、pnpm 构建环境和建好的 Webex 机器人。

say.text: 帮我通过 Chat SDK 接入 Webex 渠道
say.note: 复制适配器、追加注册 import、装依赖，然后构建并跑测试

say.text: 粘贴我的 Webex Bot Access Token，写入 .env
say.note: 会提示输入并写入 WEBEX_BOT_TOKEN

say.text: Webex 消息收不到，帮我排查 webhook

howto.what_en: It copies the Webex adapter and its registration test into src/channels/, appends a self-registration import, installs @bitbasti/chat-adapter-webex, then builds and runs the test. You paste the credentials into .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add Webex channel support to a project, e.g. wiring a Webex space to an agent. Requires the channels branch, pnpm, and a created Webex bot.

say_en.text: Add Webex channel support via the Chat SDK
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs the dep, builds and tests

say_en.text: Save my Webex Bot Access Token to .env
say_en.note: Prompts for the token and writes WEBEX_BOT_TOKEN

say_en.text: My Webex messages never reach the agent — check the webhook
say_en.note: Verifies the webhook targets /webhook/webex and is active
